summary_for_children: Ghafir means The Forgiver. It tells of a believing man in Pharaoh's family who bravely defended Musa, and of Pharaoh ordering a tower to reach the heavens out of pride.
world_title: The Tower and the Believing Man
environment_concept: A brick tower that stops far short of the sky (40:36-37) and a simple house (40:28). No one is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Monumental city with a half-built brick tower, palace halls and a simple house of the believing man.

story_library.title: The Courageous Believer
story_library.children_narration: Musa brought Allah's message to Pharaoh. In Pharaoh's own family, a believing man spoke courageously in defense of truth. He encouraged the people to think carefully about the consequences of their actions and reminded them of Allah's guidance.

world_idea.title: The Hidden Voice of Truth
world_idea.description: Explore an ancient Egyptian council setting, follow a narrated argument through interactive evidence, and learn how to speak thoughtfully even when others disagree. ## Part 3 — Surahs 41–60

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
